episodes.name: Spellbound
episodes.overviewEn: Spider-Man and Iron Man face off against the trickster, Loki, and his mind-controlling scepter!

episodes.name: Bait 'n' Switch
episodes.overviewEn: Rocket breaks into the Collector’s museum in order to try and set his buddy, Groot, free!

episodes.name: Chimichangas
episodes.overviewEn: Deadpool faces off against Venom in a hilarious new Marvel Funko animated short!

episodes.name: Cosmic Sleigh Ride
episodes.overviewEn: The Collector sends Taserface to re-capture Groot for his collection and ends up on a slippery snow chase on a frozen alien planet with Groot & Star-Lord.

episodes.name: Mjolnir Mischief
episodes.overviewEn: Loki starts a battle with his older half-brother, Thor, and the two go staff-to-hammer on a barren, rocky planet.

episodes.name: Tick Tick Smash!
episodes.overviewEn: Hulk and Black Widow need to work together using brains and brawn to escape an underground Hydra bunker full of traps and tricks.

episodes.name: Time to Unwind
episodes.overviewEn: Loki tries to sneak into Doctor Strange's Sanctum Sanctorum and soon discovers that the Cloak of Levitation is anything but a welcome mat.

episodes.name: Submarine Showdown
episodes.overviewEn: Something's lurking under the sea! Red Skull launches an attack on the island of Manhattan using a Hydra submarine, and it's up to Cap to defend New York City!

episodes.name: Big Robot, Little Problem
episodes.overviewEn: When Ultron gains possession of the Hulkbuster at Avengers HQ, Ant-Man proves that size doesn't matter - it's how you use it.

episodes.name: Rooftop Rock!
episodes.overviewEn: Spider-Gwen rocks out on a rooftop listening to her favorite tunes and is rudely interrupted by Venom - if he wants a battle, he'll have to face the music - literally!

episodes.name: Magnet Mayhem
episodes.overviewEn: Spider-Man and Iron Man take on the Vulture in a rather magnetizing display of teamwork.

episodes.name: Avengers- Endgame
episodes.overviewEn: Who's excited to see Avengers: Endgame?
